title: Work by gravity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates work done by gravity as W = mgh = 600 J.

title: Instantaneous velocity at t=2s
description: Important: Uses v = gt to find velocity at 2 seconds (20 m/s).

title: Instantaneous power formula
description: Important: Applies P = Fv = mgv for instantaneous power at t=2s.

title: Displacement in 2nd second
description: Important: Correctly calculates Δh between t=1s and t=2s using Δh = (1/2)g(t₂² - t₁²) = 15 m.

title: Average power calculation
description: Essential: Computes average power during 2nd second as P_avg = (mgΔh)/Δt = 300 W.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (J, W, m, s) throughout calculations.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for displacement or velocity in power formulas.

title: Confusing power types
description: Pitfall: Confuses instantaneous and average power, or uses wrong time interval.
